begin Sotha_EndScript

short state
short button
short messageOn
short doonce
short doonce2
short doonce3
short doonce4
float timer 
float timer2
short reset

if(MenuMode == 1)
	Return
endif

if ( reset == 1 )
	return
endif


if(AlmalexiaDead == 1)
		set timer to (timer + GetSecondsPassed)
		if(doonce == 0)
			Player->say  "vo\Sotha\SothaLine18.mp3" "So. You've made it here, and have slain my mad sister. Are you surprised to find my lifeless corpse, mortal? Or, should I say, hero? She murdered me long before you arrived, thanks to the power of the Mazed Band. But, despite my death, I am Sotha Sil, and his city, and all that you have seen."
			set doonce to 1
		endif
		if(timer > 31)
			if(doonce2 == 0)
				Player->say  "vo\Sotha\SothaLine19.mp3", "This is my realm, and though she destroyed my corporeal shell, I remain alive within the walls, gears, and circuits of this city, though the transferal was hasty and imperfect. This is why you needed to act as my hands. Now, you have a choice, mortal."
				set doonce2 to 1
			endif
		endif
		if(timer> 57)
			if(doonce3 == 0)
				Player->say  "vo\Sotha\SothaLine20.mp3", "Will you aid me one last time, and complete the process to merge me fully and perfectly with my realm, or will you slay me as well, as veangence for your predecesor? You would be well within your rights to, and I bear no ill-will should you choose to do so. Just be aware that, as I die, so too shall my city, in time, a corpse of a corpse, a dead god's husk drifting through nothing and returning to nothing."
				set doonce3 to 1
			endif
		endif
		if(timer > 98)
			if(doonce4 == 0)
				set messageOn to 1
				set doonce4 to 1
			endif
		endif
endif

if(messageOn == 1)
		MessageBox "Complete Sotha Sil's upload process, or sever his lifeline, killing him and the city?", "Upload", "Sever" 
		Set messageOn to 2
endif	

if ( messageOn ==2 )
	set button to GetButtonPressed

	if ( button == -1 )	; Nothing
		return;
	endif

	if ( button == 0 )
		Player->say  "vo\Sotha\SothaLine22.mp3", "I thank you, mortal, though not on my own behalf, but on behalf of my creations and my children living within my city. I grew weary of my own existence, but perhaps, in caring for my people, I shall find some joy again. The city is yours, as well, in all but name, and you may enter and leave at your leisure. I also leave my personal workshop to you, given that I no longer have any need for it, and lack the arms to use it besides."
		MessageBox  "In return, I have one final request. Should I begin to descend into madness, you must slay me without mercy. This will be a kindness."
		Journal, SSE_Endgame, 40
		set Sotha_Lived to 1
		Set messageOn to 0
		EnablePlayerControls
		return
	endif


	if ( button == 1 )
		Player->say  "vo\Sotha\SothaLine21.mp3", "So, you've decided to sever my spirit and return me to the Dreaming Sleeve. This is, perhaps, the best decision, and I was growing weary of my existence. I could not say for sure whether or not I would have gone down the path of my once-sister to Sheogorath's domain. You may have just done the world a great kindness, hero, though I mourn for the fate of my creations and my children."
		MessageBox "I give you my final gift, to my boon and bane, my workshop. Please treat it kindly, and take care of my city in the few years it has left."
		Journal, SSE_Endgame, 45
		set Sotha_Lived to 3
		Set messageOn to 0
		EnablePlayerControls
		return
	endif

endif

if(Sotha_Lived == 3)
	set timer2 to (timer2 + GetSecondsPassed)
	if (timer2 > 7)
		set Sotha_Lived to 2
	endif
endif


end

begin Sotha_FactoryFix

;each lever gets a script that controls itself, and moves the door based on the door's
;local state (each door has LocalState script on it).
;sounds should be tagged in animations

short state		;the state of the lever, 0 down, 1 up
short move		;tells the lever and door to move
short doonce 

if(OnActivate == 1 )
	if(Sotha_MachineFixed == 2)
		if(Sotha_LifeFixed == 1)
			if(doonce == 0)
				set move to 1
				set Sotha_FactoryFixed1 to 1
				PlaySound "SothaFabMachine"
				PlaySound "FabBossAlive"
				PlaySound "StoneSound"
				PlaySound "ThunderClap"
				MessageBox "Life and Machine systems repaired, manufactoring plant fully cleansed."
				set doonce to 1
			endif
		endif
	endif
endif

if  ( move == 1 )
	
	;animate the lever
	if ( state == 0 )
			playgroup "idle2"
			set state to 1
	else
			playgroup "idle3"
			set state to 0
	endif

	;animate the door
	if ( "act_sotha_door10".state == 0 )

			;push anims on to open
			"act_sotha_door_factory"->playgroup "idle2"
			set  "act_sotha_door_factory".state to 1

	else	
			;push anims on to close
			"act_sotha_door_factory"->playgroup "idle3"
			set  "act_sotha_door_factory".state to 0

	endif

	set move to 0

endif

end

begin sotha_machine1

;controls act_sotha_monster1
;this is the main script for the fabricant machine
;it decides if fabricants are made and plays the anims for everything, opens the doors, etc

;sotha_machine2 script controls the second lever and the second door only

short state		;the state of the lever, 0 down, 1 up
short move		;tells the lever and door to move
float timer		;for timing the creature making and such
short make		;true when making creature and controlling door #1
float timer2		;for timing player getting stuck in machine
short inside		;for making sure player isn't inside

;******************************************
;  turn lever and open the door
;
;******************************************

if ( OnActivate == 1 )

	;can only move this lever if the second other door is shut and no creature is being made
	;otherwise, play sound

	if (  "act_sotha_mach_door2".state == 0 )
		if ( make == 0 )
			set move to 1
		endif
	else
		playsound "LockedDoor"
	endif

endif

if  ( move == 1 )
	
	;animate the lever
	if ( state == 0 )
			playgroup "idle2"
			set state to 1
	else
			playgroup "idle3"
			set state to 0
	endif

	;animate the door
	if (  "act_sotha_mach_door1".state == 0 )

			;push anims on to open
			"act_sotha_mach_door1"->playgroup "idle2"
			set  "act_sotha_mach_door1".state to 1

	else	
			;push anims on to close
			"act_sotha_mach_door1"->playgroup "idle3"
			set  "act_sotha_mach_door1".state to 0

	endif

	set move to 0

endif


;******************************************
;  make creatures, open door, etc
;
;******************************************

;check status of doors and the state of making fabs

if ( make == 0 )
	if (  "act_sotha_mach_door1".state == 0 )
		if (  "act_sotha_mach_door2".state == 0 )	
			if ( timer > 15 )		;only makes them every 10 seconds
				set make to 10	
				set timer to 0	
			else
				set timer to ( timer + GetSecondsPassed )
			endif
		endif
	endif
endif

if ( make >= 10 )

	;play the anim and sound
	if ( make == 10 )
		playsound "SothaFabMachine"
		"act_sotha_powertubes"->loopgroup idle2 6
		set make to 20
	endif

	;open door for creature after 5 secs
	if ( make == 20 )
		if ( timer > 3 )		;door opens in 3 seconds and creature is made, it is in these 3 seconds you can open other door

			PlaceItemCell, "fabricant_machine_1", "Sotha Sil, Sanctum of Serlyn" 4364, 5091, 12541, 190
			"act_sotha_mach_door1"->playgroup "idle2"
			set  "act_sotha_mach_door1".state to 1
			"act_sotha_powertubes"->playgroup idle
			set make to 30	
			set timer to 0	

		else
			set timer to ( timer + GetSecondsPassed )
		endif

	endif

	;close the door behind the creature and reset
	if ( make == 30 )
		if ( timer > 7 )		;door closes in 7 seconds

			;push anims on to close
			if ( act_sotha_collide->GetStandingPC == 1 )
				set timer2 to 0
				set inside to 1
				return
			else
				set timer2 to ( timer2 + GetSecondsPassed )
				if ( timer2 < 5 )
					return
				endif
				set inside to 0
				if ( inside == 0 )
					"act_sotha_mach_door1"->playgroup "idle3"
					set  "act_sotha_mach_door1".state to 0
					set make to 0		;can now make again
					set timer to 0	
				endif
			endif
		else
			set timer to ( timer + GetSecondsPassed )
		endif

	endif

endif

end
